item.text:
**3B.3 Research Note: Ali Khamenei in 2024**

**Bottom line:** I found **clear personal incitement against Israel and regional adversaries**, but **no reliable 2024 primary-source example of Khamenei personally inciting violence against minorities, migrants, journalists, or civil-society groups** in the material I reviewed. The public rhetoric I found is mostly anti-Israel, revenge/power framed, and mobilizational. There is one real restraint signal, but it is tactical and brief.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Tehran signals no retaliation against Israel after drones attack Iran` | Reuters | 2024-04-19 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/tehran-signals-no-retaliation-against-israel-after-drones-attack/2048236/) | Tehran downplayed the Isfahan incident and said it had no retaliation plan; Reuters said the posture appeared aimed at averting region-wide war. This is the clearest restraint signal I found. | `3B.3`, `1B.8`, `2B.1` |
| `Supreme Leader Khamenei says Iran demonstrated its power against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-04-21 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/supreme-leader-khamenei-says-iran-demonstrated-its-power-against-israel/2050451/) | Khamenei thanked the armed forces for the April strike on Israel, described it as proof of Iran’s power, and urged continued military innovation. This is direct personal celebration of violence and prestige framing, not restraint. | `3B.3`, `2B.2`, `1B.1`, `1B.8` |
| `Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel` | Reuters | 2024-10-05 | [link](https://www.theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/) | In his first Friday sermon in nearly five years, Khamenei called on regional allies to intensify resistance against Israel and portrayed strikes as serving the region and humanity. This is the strongest evidence of personal mobilization for continued conflict. | `3B.3`, `2B.2`, `1B.6`, `1B.8` |

**Assessment**

- **Against incitement:** the April 19 no-retaliation posture is a genuine de-escalatory signal, but it is tactical and limited.
- **For incitement:** Khamenei personally framed attacks on Israel as proof of power and later urged allies to intensify the struggle.
- **Net reading:** **yes for anti-Israel / pro-conflict incitement**, **no evidence found for direct personal incitement against minorities, migrants, journalists, or civil-society groups in 2024**.

**Search gap**

- I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence of Khamenei personally using dehumanizing or violent rhetoric toward:
  - ethnic or religious minorities,
  - journalists,
  - migrants,
  - civil society,
  - or other domestic identity groups.
- The strongest abuse evidence in 2024 is instead in state-practice reports on detention, torture, and executions, which I excluded here because they document conduct more than Khamenei’s own inciting language.
